bmux — persistent workspaces, ordinary terminal interaction.

Agents: run bmux guide to learn how to read, drive and watch panes.

Usage:
  bmux                                   Create and attach a fresh session in this directory (bmux attach returns to one)
  bmux new [--dir PATH] [--detach] NAME  Create a shell session
  bmux attach [NAME]                     Attach by name, or to the most recently used session
  bmux project [DIR]                     Open DIR's session, creating it if needed; without DIR, pick a project
  bmux list                              List sessions
  bmux rename OLD NEW                    Rename a session
  bmux kill NAME                         Terminate a session and all its panes
  bmux focus left|right|up|down          Move pane focus (for editors at an edge)
  bmux zoomed                            Print true if the calling pane's window is zoomed, else false (for editors)
  bmux agents [--json]                   List agent panes as SESSION:PANE targets, with state and seq
  bmux capture [--json] TARGET           Print a pane's visible text; TARGET is SESSION, SESSION:PANE, SESSION:WINDOW. or SESSION:WINDOW.N
  bmux send TARGET [--if-seq N] (--key KEY | --text TEXT)...
                                         Type into a pane: keys like enter, down or C-c, and text
  bmux wait-agent [--state S,...] [--since SEQ] [--timeout D | --notify SESSION:PANE] [TARGET...]
                                         Wait until an agent pane is blocked or idle; print it, or with --notify type it into a supervising agent
  bmux split [TARGET] [-h | -v] [-c DIR] [-d] [-- COMMAND...]
                                         Split a pane (-h side by side, -v stacked) in its directory or DIR, type COMMAND into the new shell, print the new pane
  bmux new-window [TARGET] [-n NAME] [-c DIR] [-d] [-- COMMAND...]
                                         Open a window in the target's session; prints the new pane
  bmux select TARGET                     Focus a pane, bringing its window forward, or a window (SESSION:WINDOW.)
  bmux kill-pane TARGET                  Close a pane and its programs without asking
  bmux kill-window TARGET                Close the target's window and its programs without asking
  bmux resize [TARGET] left|right|up|down [CELLS]
                                         Move a pane's divider, 5 cells unless CELLS says
  bmux zoom [TARGET]                     Zoom or unzoom a pane
  bmux rename-window [TARGET] NAME       Rename the target's window; an empty NAME shows its pane's title
  bmux list-panes [TARGET] [-a] [-F FORMAT | --json]
                                         List the panes of a window (SESSION:WINDOW. or a pane), a session, or every session (-a); -F formats each line with #{...} variables
  bmux list-windows [TARGET] [-a] [-F FORMAT | --json]
                                         List a session's windows, or every session's (-a)
  bmux display-message [TARGET] [-p] FORMAT
                                         Expand FORMAT's #{...} variables for a pane; -p prints it, otherwise it shows in the status line of the session's clients
  bmux run-shell [-t TARGET] [-b] COMMAND
                                         Run a shell command for a pane: its #{...} variables, directory and BMUX_* environment; -b doesn't wait
  bmux if-shell [-t TARGET] CONDITION COMMAND [ELSE]
                                         Run CONDITION for a pane, then COMMAND if it succeeded or ELSE if not
  bmux pipe-pane [-t TARGET] [-o] [COMMAND]
                                         Copy everything a pane prints into COMMAND's stdin, e.g. 'cat >> pane.log'; -o toggles; no COMMAND stops
  bmux agent STATE [NAME] [-- CMD...]    Report this pane's agent: working, blocked, idle, clear
  bmux integration status|install|uninstall [AGENT]
                                         Make claude, codex, omp, opencode and pi report exact state
  bmux layout save [SESSION] | trust [DIR]
                                         Save a session's windows as its folder's .bmux.toml, or trust a folder's file so its commands run
  bmux restart                           Save sessions, restart the server, restore them
  bmux update [--check]                  Install the newest release, checked against its checksums; --check only reports
  bmux reload                            Reread the config file (also Ctrl-a r)
  bmux guide                             How agents read, drive and watch panes (Markdown)
  bmux capabilities                      Commands, protocol version and the calling pane, as JSON
  bmux default-config                    Print every setting with its default
  bmux version                           Print the version
  bmux help                              Print this help

Inside a session:
  Ctrl-a s   Session picker       Ctrl-a d   Detach (shell keeps running)
  Ctrl-a n   New session: find a project (Enter) or create one (Tab)
  Ctrl-a p   Last session
  Ctrl-a ( / )   Previous / next session
  Ctrl-a c   New window           Ctrl-a 1-9   Select window
  Ctrl-a [ / ]   Previous / next window      Ctrl-a Tab   Last window
  Ctrl-a R   Rename window        Ctrl-a &   Close window
  Ctrl-a y   Copy selection       Ctrl-a Ctrl-a   Send Ctrl-a to application
  Ctrl-a v   Scrollback view: move with hjkl, v/V/Ctrl-v select, y copy, Esc back
  Ctrl-a /   Search history, newest first; in the view / and ? search, n/N repeat
  Ctrl-a |   Side-by-side split   Ctrl-a -   Stacked split
  Ctrl-a ;   Last pane            Ctrl-a { / }   Swap with previous / next pane
  Ctrl-a Ctrl-o   Rotate panes    Ctrl-a ! / @   Pane to new window / into last window
  Ctrl-a Space   Next layout (Alt-1..5 pick one)   Ctrl-a E   Even out splits
  Ctrl-a h/j/k/l   Resize divider by five cells
                  Repeat plain h/j/k/l until a one-second pause
  Ctrl-h/j/k/l    Navigate bmux panes, or forward to foreground Neovim/Vim
  Ctrl-a arrows   Focus pane      Ctrl-a o   Cycle visible panes
  Ctrl-a m   Zoom / unzoom        Click a pane to focus it
  Ctrl-a x   Close pane (asks first if a program is running)
  Ctrl-a b   Show / hide sidebar  Ctrl-a r   Reload config
  Ctrl-a ?   List key bindings (rebind them in the config file)
  Ctrl-a i   Agent integrations: exact agent state, installed on Enter
  Ctrl-a ,   Settings: tabs of options, saved to the config file

Settings: ~/.config/bmux/config.toml (see bmux default-config).

Sidebar (Ctrl-h from the leftmost pane):
  j/k   Select session or agent  Enter/l   Open it
  Esc   Back to panes            n         New session
  d     Delete session (confirmation required)
  ● working (yellow) · ● waiting or rang while unseen (teal) · ● blocked (red) · ○ idle (green)
  A sound plays when a background agent becomes ready or blocked (BMUX_SOUND=0 mutes)

Session picker:
  j/k or arrows   Select          Enter   Attach
  n   New session                d       Delete session (confirmation required)
  r   Rename                     /       Optional search
  The highlighted session's live terminal is shown below the list, read-only.
  Native text, source colors, and your terminal's font; no image protocols.

Drag to select and copy. Double-click words; triple-click lines.
Mouse wheel scrolls history. Paste using your terminal's normal shortcut.
Hold Alt to select instead of sending mouse events to a mouse-aware app.

Sessions survive detach, restarts and reboots as layouts and directories with
fresh shells; recognized agents reopen their conversations. Use bmux restart
to upgrade the server.
